# Proqi 0.10.2

Proqi 0.10.2 fixes an upgrade failure that prevented existing sessions with
numbered attachments from opening in 0.10.0 and 0.10.1.

## Highlights

- Databases that already have stable attachment numbers now upgrade without
  the erroneous `storage is corrupt or malformed: ordinal in legacy schema`
  error. The migration no longer tries to assign attachment numbers a second
  time.
- Existing attachment numbers, numbering counters, thought content, and undo
  history are preserved during migration. Older databases that still need
  attachment numbering continue to receive it once.
- Earlier database migration dates are preserved. Only newly applied
  migrations receive a new timestamp.

## Upgrade

For Homebrew installations:

```shell
brew update
brew upgrade --formula oborchers/tap/proqi
```

If the previous version stopped with `ordinal in legacy schema`, upgrade and
retry the same resume command. That failed migration rolled back; this fix
does not require deleting your database or editing attachment metadata.

If Proqi lists older running sessions as migration blockers, close those
sessions cleanly and retry.
